metadata.description: DevBench authoring marketplace -- ships the devbench-authoring plugin (spec authoring + backlog materialization phase) and the devbench-backlog-assistant plugin (operator-phase diagnosis and remediation). Adds operator-mode amendment and backlog-assistant capabilities. The companion devbench-orchestrate marketplace lives at plugin/ in the same repo (issue #224).

plugins.name: devbench-authoring
plugins.description: Spec authoring + backlog materialization skills (spec-to-backlog, create-spec, configure-devbench, bootstrap-environment) with operator-mode amendment support. No hooks; safe to enable in any workspace where authoring happens. Use during the planning phase.

plugins.name: devbench-backlog-assistant
plugins.description: Operator-phase backlog-assistant for diagnosis and remediation. Ships nine read-only diagnosis skills and payload skills that print mutating commands but never run them without CONFIRM. Use when work units are blocked, backlogs drift, or review is stuck.
